title: Claim procedure (damaged, lost, late) — Shopee, Lazada, corporate
keywords: claim damaged lost missing broken smashed compensation investigate liable 5 days express@uparcel.sg
body: Claims must reach express@uparcel.sg within 5 calendar days of delivery; later claims are rejected.
1. Log every claim, valid or not, in the Claims file and withhold the agent's pay.
2. Admin Panel > User > Agent: set 'Have Claims?' to Yes (blocks instant cash-out).
3. Investigate: delivered within the time frame? POD and GPS valid? If not, ask the agent for POD, call logs or message logs.
4. Decide: 2 or more of POD, GPS, call logs, message logs valid → reject. 1 or fewer → accept. Late and damaged → accept, unless frozen goods were delivered within 5 hrs of pickup.
5. Invalid: reject and release pay. Valid: get the claim form (with proof of refund) from the merchant or Shopee CS; send to Finance and Shopee CS.
6. Close the case in the Claims file. Shopee pays the seller; uParcel never pays sellers directly.
escalate: Unclear cases → Faiq or Carmen. Claims over the agreed limit → CFO.
